edges.mechanism: Rising unemployment makes a cut at the October meeting more likely.

evidence.supports: Unemployment rate has risen since mid-2025, the labour premise for a cut.
January minutes show several participants had already discussed further downward adjustments; dated background for a cut case.
Describes September jobs growth as weaker overall but the labour market as solid and stable.
evidence.rebuttal: It does not deny that unemployment has risen since mid-2025 (web-009); it only weakens the urgency of a labour-driven cut.

edges.mechanism: Re-accelerating inflation and a hawkish policy stance make a cut less likely.

evidence.supports: Governor says policy will focus on the inflation side of the mandate for at least the near term, against a cut.
Headline CPI rose to 3.7% y/y in September, up from 3.4%, against a cut.
Hopes for a quick end to the Middle East conflict faded and oil may stay high, sustaining inflation pressure.
September minutes: most participants assessed another rate increase as likely, not a cut.
Futures prices show about an 85 percent chance of at least one hike by year-end, so markets do not price cuts.

edges.mechanism: A policy-rate cut lowers the expected policy path and pulls long-dated Treasury yields down.
Lower yields raise TLT prices, since long-duration bonds are the most rate-sensitive.
A cut that appears to ease policy before inflation is contained can raise long-end term premium.
Persistent inflation lifts the long-end term premium that investors require.
A higher long-end term premium lowers TLT prices.

conditions.threshold_note: The 25bp size is the user's stated size; no numeric threshold is needed for an event. User to confirm the 2026-10-28 statement counts.
conditions.rule: Met if the FOMC statement released 2026-10-28 lowers the federal funds target range by 25 basis points. Not met if the range is held or moved by another amount.

conditions.threshold_note: Negative form of cond.cut; no threshold needed.
conditions.rule: Met if the FOMC statement released 2026-10-28 does not lower the target range by 25 basis points. Not met if the 25bp cut is announced.

conditions.series: 20-year US Treasury constant maturity yield (FRED DGS20)
conditions.source: US Treasury yield curve via FRED
conditions.threshold_note: The size of the required yield decline is not in the material. User should set it, for example relative to the 2026-10-27 close. Data source should confirm the series.
conditions.rule: Met if the 20-year yield closes below its 2026-10-27 level on any trading day through the deadline. Not met if it never does.

conditions.series: 20-year US Treasury constant maturity yield (FRED DGS20)
conditions.source: US Treasury yield curve via FRED
conditions.threshold_note: The rise needed to signal a term-premium shock is unknown. User should set it. The 2-year yield comparison needs the same data source.
conditions.rule: Met if the 20-year yield closes above its 2026-10-27 level while the 2-year yield closes below its 2026-10-27 level on the same day. Not met otherwise.
